fusions.name: Reap the Hunted
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health and deals 20 damage, plus 1.6 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which are used up.

fusions.name: Crescent Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps every enemy within 3 tiles for 8 damage. You hold up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Harvest Home
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Rush
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
